concerns.text: FR-004 mandates a spatial split (train: Eastern US, test: Western US). The tasks (T020) and plan implement a purely temporal split (2015-2020 vs 2022). No task exists to implement the spatial split logic or handle the Eastern/Western US data partitioning required by the spec.

FR-006 explicitly requires a Linear Mixed-Effects Model (LMM) with Grid Cell as a random effect. The plan rejects this in favor of Bootstrap Resampling, and Task T028 implements Bootstrap. There is no task to implement the LMM or the specific statistical comparison defined in FR-006.

FR-007 requires generating 'continental-scale maps'. Task T025 only implements 'regional map generation' for the Lake Powell region. No task exists to generate the continental-scale visualization required by the spec.

SC-002 requires measuring statistical significance against an LMM p-value threshold. Since the LMM is not implemented (replaced by Bootstrap in T029), there is no task to produce the specific LMM p-values required to satisfy this success criterion.

FR-003 requires excluding grid cells with total annual counts < 10 from the analysis. Task T014 mentions excluding them from the calculation, but Task T015 (sensitivity sweep) does not explicitly state that the < 10 exclusion applies to the sweep, creating a potential gap in coverage for the full requirement scope.
